Next.js (TypeScript, App Router) in `src`; UI `src/components`, hooks `src/hooks`, utilities `src/lib`, routes `src/app` (API: `src/app/api/*`), assets `public/`, scripts `scripts/` (e.g., `scripts/setup-db.ts`). Standalone Vite environment: `vite-base-template/`.

Commands: `npm run dev` (Next.js/Turbopack, `http://localhost:3000`); `npm run build`; `npm run start`; `npm run lint`; `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev` (Vite, `:5173`); `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`.

TypeScript strict, `noEmit: true`; alias `@/*` → `src/*`. ESLint: Next.js + TypeScript (`eslint.config.mjs`); `<REDACTED_USER>/no-explicit-any` disabled. Use 2-space indentation, PascalCase components, camelCase variables/functions, kebab-case files (Next.js conventions: `page.tsx`, `route.ts`). Tailwind CSS v4.

No test runner configured. Prefer Vitest or Jest + React Testing Library; colocate `Component.test.tsx` or use `__tests__/`; cover critical paths (core components, API handlers).

Commit messages: concise, imperative, optionally scoped (e.g., `feat(editor): add split panes`, `fix(api): handle 500 on export`).

PRs must include summary/rationale, local test steps (screenshots for UI changes), linked issues, and checklist: builds, lints, runs locally.

Use `.env.local` for developer machines; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` vars are client-exposed. Rotate leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys. Rewrites `/iframe/*` to dynamic API (`src/app/api/iframe`).
